idea: Agritourism development advisory: design plus financial modelling
buyer: Italian estate owners and foreign buyers converting rural property
pain: They convert farms into hospitality with no design coherence or financial plan
v1: A conversion feasibility with design concept and model
verdict: Uses architecture, finance and the Italian connection at once; charming, small, and slow.

why.distribution: Estate owners reachable through her husband's contacts, one at a time.
why.demand: Owners do pay architects and consultants for conversions.
why.fmf: Architecture, development appraisal and Italian access simultaneously - almost nobody offers this.
why.defensibility: The trilingual design-plus-finance-plus-local-access combination is essentially unique.
why.tailwind: Agritourism is growing steadily in Italy.
why.ceiling: £18k x 11 projects = £198k, but eleven Italian conversion projects a year is impossible solo and remote.

ceiling_arithmetic: £18k x 11 projects = £198k less ~25% local professional costs = £148k. Eleven projects in Italy managed from London is not deliverable. Realistic: 2-3 = £27-40k net.
carries: Uses three assets at once and is genuinely differentiated. Also the idea she would probably most enjoy.
kills: Geography and leverage. Remote delivery of design-led projects in Italy caps the count at a handful.
test: Ask her husband's contacts whether two owners are considering conversion.
test_pass: One pays for a feasibility study.
